Horadric is the [[NPCs|NPC]] innkeeper at [[The Dead Horse]] and the husband of [[Miss Chain]]. He is obligated by ancient contract to purchase your [[Burial certificate]] for the constant price of {{Money|150}}.

==Quests==
===Deliver the Letter===
The innkeeper asks you to deliver a letter to his friend, [[Krezvold]] the Blacksmith. After delivering the letter, you can return to Horadric and get {{Item|A mug of beer||copper}} as reward. It can be, and is most likely expected, to be given to [[Gerry]] to complete one of his quests. You'll earn 10 {{Happiness}} by doing such.

===Return With Royal Stamp===
After asking if he will purchase your {{Item|Flesh}}, he mentions that he would love to, but all meat must have a {{Item|stamp}} to be genuine. The stamp can be obtained in two ways. The first method of obtaining a stamp involves purchasing one the royal service box (left of the [[Church]]) for {{Money|5000}}, after achieving a high enough "relationship" with it. The second method is to visit [[Snake]] in the Cellar, and after you reach {{Happiness}}30 with him, you will be able to ask him to give you a forged stamp. After returning to Horadric, he will teach you how to make a {{Item|Package of meat}} using {{Item|Clean paper}} and {{Item|Flesh}}, along with the {{Item|stamp}}. The stamp is not consumed by crafting.

===Unlock the Kitchen Garden===
After reading the sign in the north part of the [[Kitchen Garden]] you can ask the innkeeper about it and receive a {{item|Garden certificate}} to open it up.

===Bring Beer===
After selling {{Item|A mug of beer||gold}} and {{Item|Burger||gold}} (both must be {{quality|gold}}) at a [[Witch Hill]] burning (see [[Inquisitor]] for more details), Horadric asks you to bring him a mug of this famous beer. If you do so, you'll gain another 10 {{Happiness}} after you update the Church to Big Church. If you have 30 {{Happiness}}, you can access a private area of the Dead Horse, where you can get the recipe for Mead at his desk. 

('''Note:''' In the current version of the game you will need 30 {{Happiness}} to gain access to the upstairs room. You need to upgrade the church to get the 30 {{Happiness}}).

===Beer Snacks===
After obtaining an {{Item|onion||copper}} at some point previously (either bought from [[Farmer]] or planted and harvested, must be {{quality|copper}}), [[Horadric]] will give you the recipe for [[Onion rings]] and [[Toasts with onions]] after talking to him.
